title: TMH workflow (D509, standards 24)
description: The neutral flow format that flow_diagram.py draws. Each chat writes a small adapter from its own system (Resend, n8n, Odoo) into this. Words on the steps are the owning chat's.

title.description: shown top left, for example 'Welcome flow'

source.description: GitHub link to the definition this was made from

made.description: date shown in the footer; today if left out

label.description: at most three lines at 14 px (about 70 characters)

note.description: a smaller line under the label: the system, the time-out, the code

tags.description: markets or channels, shown as UK · US · EU

link.description: where the step lives (template, n8n flow, SOP section); clickable inline, listed under an image

next.description: the next step id, or a list; the first is the main way on, each other gets its own column
